title: Tenant registry
description: Two-level tenant model: one client, N surfaces. Every page document carries the tenantId it belongs to, and the loader refuses to serve a page across tenants.

stableId.description: PRD FR-12: ids serialise as config and survive migration to Mitsu, so they are lowercase kebab and never renumbered.

basePath.description: '/' for the primary surface, or a bare segment path like '/mill'. No trailing slash: the tenant resolver normalises before matching, and allowing both forms would let two surfaces declare the same prefix.

parentTenantId.description: null for the primary surface. Set for a surface of the same client.

navOrder.description: Site-absolute paths, in the order the nav renders them. The loader returns pages in path order, which cannot express an arbitrary order (path order gives Home, Shop, Help, About — not Home, Shop, About, Help). Pages absent from this list keep path order and follow the listed ones, so adding a page still adds a nav item without editing this file.

externalLinks.description: Links to the client's OTHER properties, shown in the header beside the nav. Absolute URLs only: anything internal is a page and belongs in navOrder.

signIn.description: The account entry point rendered in the header. A label and an href, not a Clerk integration: the destination is whatever hosts the account surface, which may be a route on this site or a hosted page.

headerCta.description: The header's primary call to action — the commercial ask that belongs on every page. Distinct from signIn, which is the account entry point rather than a CTA.

socialLinks.description: Social accounts belonging to the client's own operations. Separate from externalLinks because these are the mill's, not the shop's — and because the header shows externalLinks and would otherwise grow a row of icons.
